meta.title: A330 Phase Flows
meta.quickref: training/A330 OEM Quick Reference MyVersion1.pdf, 2 pages, transcribed visually
meta.authority: A330P FCOM PRO-NOR is the authority for step wording and switch state; the quick reference is the authority for order, triggers and role
meta.fcom_source: A330P FCOM R17 PRO-NOR (HAL A330 fleet, 15 MAY 26 revision), idents quoted as printed

fcom.note: FCOM GENERAL is a paragraph, not a step line: check for, or be informed of, obstructions near the aircraft, engineering activity, refueling activity. No role suffix printed; the section is CM2-CM3 in PRO-NOR-TSK.
FCOM role is CM2-CM3 (CM3 when carried).
FCOM role is CM2-CM3. Warning: if any gear door is open do not pressurize hydraulics until cleared by ground personnel.
FCOM role is CM2-CM3. Observe that the APU inlet and outlet are clear.
Same DU also has ENG START selector......NORM CM2, which the card does not list.
Same DU: CAPT DISPLAY mode selector OFF, F/O DISPLAY mode selector OFF, GAIN knob AUTO, TURB sw AUTO, all CM2.

fcom.line: BAT 1 pb-sw, BAT 2 pb-sw and APU BAT pb-sw......AUTO
fcom.note: Card says Bat ON; FCOM line is BAT 1 pb-sw, BAT 2 pb-sw and APU BAT pb-sw......AUTO CM2 (the pb-sw positions are AUTO and OFF, there is no ON label). Wording-level conflict, same physical action. Same DU: EXT PWR pb......ON CM2 when the AVAIL light is on, and a battery voltage check above 25.5 V if the aircraft has been unpowered 6 h or more.
Card names RMP 1 only; FCOM checks RMP 1 and 2 ON, green NAV light OFF, and tunes COM frequencies (VHF 1 ATC, VHF 2 ATIS/company, VHF 3 ACARS).

fcom.line: APU FIRE TEST pb......PRESS and MAINTAIN
fcom.note: Same DU first checks APU FIRE pb-sw IN and GUARDED and APU AGENT light OFF.
Preceded in the same DU by APU MASTER SW pb-sw......ON CM2.
When the APU is AVAIL. Same DU: X-BLEED rotary selector AUTO, COCKPIT TEMP and CABIN TEMP AS RQRD, EXT PWR pb AS RQRD. Do not use APU BLEED if a ground air unit is connected.
Card says ADIRS ON; FCOM line is ALL IR MODE selector......NAV CM2 (selector positions are OFF, NAV, ATT). Wording-level conflict, same physical action.
INT LT, FLOOD LT, INTEG LT including glareshield and FCU.

FMGS PRE-INITIALIZATION - CHECK THE MCDU. Same DU continues with MCDU ANNUNCIATOR LIGHTS OFF, DATA page A/C STATUS CHECK, ACTIVE NAV DATABASE CYCLE, FMS DATABASE VALIDITY CHECK, NAVAID DESELECTION AS RQRD, INIT A page FLIGHT PLAN UPLINK REQUEST, all CM1.
FCOM role suffix is ALL (every flight crewmember). Same DU: EFB/eQRH VERSION CHECK ALL, EFB STATUS page INSERT/CHECK ALL.

Same DU: LOGBOOK AND MEL/CDL ITEMS......CHECK ALL, AIRCRAFT CONFIGURATION SUMMARY......CHECK ALL, OEB......CHECK ALL. FCOM note: acceptance may be performed later but must be complete by the end of Cockpit Preparation.
The AIRCRAFT ACCEPTANCE......PERFORM line itself is CM1 only; CM2 takes part through the ALL items in the same DU (logbook and MEL/CDL, configuration summary, OEB).
Prepare charts; ensure flight plan routing and ETPs are in Jeppesen FD Pro.
Card shows this in a PF | PM sub-block under the CM1 | CM2 card. On the ACARS INIT page input/check departure, destination, flight number and date.
From the AeroData TPR or TLR: runway, intersection, flap setting, anti-ice, packs, thrust option.
Same DU on the HYD SD page: RESERVOIR FLUID LEVEL......CHECK WITHIN NORMAL RANGE PM; on the ENG SD page: ENG OIL QUANTITY......CHECK PM. If OXY is half boxed amber, check MIN FLT CREW OXY CHART.
FCOM says check the FLAPS position agrees with the handle position; it does not name UP. Warning: if surfaces disagree with handles, check with maintenance before applying hydraulic power.

fcom.line: * SPEED BRAKE lever......CHECK RETRACTED and DISARMED

fcom.note: Must be in the green band; recharge with the blue electric pump if required.
Avoid applying if one brake is above 500 C (350 C with brake fans ON) unless operationally necessary.

ALTERNATE BRAKING SYSTEM check, before the first flight of the day. Sequence in the DU: CHOCKS CHECK IN PLACE, PARK BRK handle OFF, BRAKE PEDALS PRESS, BRAKE PRESSURE CHECK (2 200 to 2 700 PSI at full deflection, symmetric), BRAKE PEDALS RELEASE, PARK BRK handle ON, all PM.

fcom.line: RAIN RPLNT indicators......CHECK PRESSURE and QUANTITY

fcom.note: Check that the three gear pins are onboard and stowed.

Card item is an umbrella for the whole OVERHEAD PANEL scan, DUs PRO-NOR-SOP-06-A-00011857 through 00011870: white lights, RCDR, EVAC, STARLINK, RESET, EXTERIOR LIGHTS, SIGNS, PROBE/WINDOW HEAT, CABIN PRESS, AIR COND, ELEC, FUEL, ENG FIRE test, MAINTENANCE PANEL, CARGO AIR COND, 3rd occupant PA, CVR test, DATA LOADER. All PF.

The walkaround DUs in PRO-NOR-SOP-05 carry no role suffix. Role comes from PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00011855.0001001 GENERAL: the PF prepares the overhead panel, the center instrument panel and the pedestal while the PM performs the external walkaround. With augmented crew the additional crew member does the walkaround unless CM1 assigns otherwise.
Umbrella for CTR INSTRUMENT PANEL, DUs 00011875 through 00011879: ISIS, NORTH REF, ECAM switching panel, CLOCK, LDG GEAR GRVTY EXTN OFF, A/SKID & N/W STRG ON. All PF.

Umbrella for PEDESTAL, DUs 00011889 through 00011888: RMP, ACP, PARKING BRK, COCKPIT DOOR test, SWITCHING PANEL, ENGINES (thrust levers IDLE, reversers STOWED, masters OFF, ENG START NORM), ATC/TCAS STBY. All PF.

Hawaiian mnemonic, not an FCOM term. It spans FMGES PREPARATION DUs 90000090 (INIT A), 90000091 (F-PLN), 90000092 (SEC F-PLN), 90000093 (RAD NAV), 90000094 (INIT B), 90000095 (PERF), 90000096 (PROG), plus 00011904 RNP, 00020964 DERATED CLIMB, 00011905 PRESET SPEEDS. The A is not expanded on the card; ATC DATALINK COMMUNICATION (PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00013823.0001001, MSG ERASE and ADS CHECK ARMED, PF) precedes the FMGES section. Every line is PF.

After the PF prepares the FMS the PM checks all data entered: departure route waypoints and constraints, flight plan vs CFP, initial cruise altitude, total track miles, fuel at destination, performance data, TRANS ALT, SEC flight plan.

GLARESHIELD section: LOUDSPEAKER knob SET PF-PM (00011907), EFIS CP baro SET/CROSSCHECK BOTH, FD CHECK ON, LS, ND MODE and RANGE, ADF/VOR sw AS RQRD PF-PM (00020728), FCU SPD/MACH DASHED, HDG-V/S, ALT window INITIAL EXPECTED CLEARANCE ALTITUDE PF (00011909).
Then on the ECAM DOOR/OXY SD page REGUL LO PR indication CHECK NOT DISPLAYED PF-PM. Warn the ground crew on intercom before the mask test.
INSTRUMENT PANELS: EFIS DMC selector CHECK NORM, PFD and ND brightness AS RQRD, PFD CHECK, ND CHECK, all PF-PM.
Same DU: STS pb......PRESS PF (INOP SYS compatible with MEL). FUEL is FUEL ON BOARD......CHECK PF-PM in PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00024946.0001001 (ECAM FOB vs CFP block fuel, balance and CG on FUEL SD page).
POSITION MONITOR page: IRS in NAV, each IRS within 5 NM of FMS position; ND position consistent with airport, SID and navaids.
Electronically accept latest release version, fitness for duty, FOB and PDSC time via OPS CTRL MSG page in ACARS.
Via VHF, ACARS PDC or CPDLC DCL.
PF reads from the ND in PLAN mode with CSTR on; PM verifies against flight plan, Jeppesen charts and ATC clearance. Finish by confirming F-PLN DIST and destination EFOB against the release.
Threat based departure briefing per FOM.
Select the prompt when it appears; the FMS uploads final weight data and takeoff performance.

Both crew members check flight number/date, aircraft, crew count, TOF, TOW vs planned, TOB, jumpseats, ZFW/ZFWCG, NOTOC, AVI, FAM. Then ZFW/ZFWCG CHECK/REVISE PF and PM, and LOADCLOSEOUT (MACTOW) CG vs ECAM CG CHECK PF-PM.

Same PF-PM line. FCOM also has LOAD CLOSEOUT VERBAL CROSS-CHECKS (passenger and jumpseat count announced by CM2 and verified by CM1 against the Flight Deck Report; flight and tail number announced by CM2 and verified by CM1 against the release; remarks announced by CM2) which the card does not show.
ECAM FOB above Minimum Release Fuel on the flight plan.

fcom.line: TAKEOFF PERFORMANCE......UPLINK FLX or UPLINK TOGA
fcom.note: If takeoff data will be uplinked. Then FLAPS/THS reminder......INSERT PF. Manual entry branch (T.O SHIFT, V1 VR V2, FLX TO TEMP, THR RED/ACC, ENG OUT ACC, all PF) is not on the card.

Both check aircraft/flight/date, wind/OAT/QNH, FINAL TPR, remarks, runway/intersection, EO departure procedure, packs, V speeds, flap config/THS, FLEX/TOGA, GTOW vs MTOW. Then FMS TAKEOFF DATA CHECK/REVISE PF and PM.
Two lines in the DU: FMS PERF TO page......SELECT PF and FMS F-PLN page......SELECT PM. Card shows it as one coordinated item.

fcom.line: SEATS, SEAT BELTS, HARNESSES, RUDDER PEDALS, ARMRESTS......ADJUST
fcom.note: Eyes aligned with the red and white balls. The FCOM prints this line wrapped across three lines with the PF-PM suffix between the leader dots and ADJUST; collapsed here.

No FCOM PRO-NOR step named Circle Check. Searched circle, circle check across PRO-NOR, FCTM and NPC-CB with no hit. The FCOM steps that sit in this position of the procedure are PITOT COVERS......REMOVED PF (PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-90000430.9000392) and AIR CONDITIONING UNITS......CHECK DISCONNECTED PF, EXT PWR pb......CHECK AVAIL PF, EXT PWR DISCONNECTION......REQUEST PF (PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00011060.0001001), which are the likely referent but are not confirmed as such by any manual.
FCOM places this line at the head of AT PUSHBACK/START CLEARANCE (the Before Start flow section). Obtain ATC pushback/start clearance and ground crew clearance.

phases.label: Before Start
phases.title: Before Start Flow

fcom.note: When cleared for start or pushback.
Set in accordance with airport requirements.
Push the sliding window handle fully forward and confirm the red indicator is no longer visible.
Doors closed on the ECAM lower display (same DU, WINDOWS and DOORS......CHECK CLOSED PF-PM), cockpit door closed and locked; slides armed on the ECAM lower display.
Caution: engines start regardless of thrust lever position.

If pushback is not required (00011066): PARK BRK ON, BRAKES PRESS CHECK, BEFORE START C/L. If pushback is required (PRO-NOR-SOP-07-B-00011062.0001001): PARK BRK ON, N/WS DISC MEMO CHECK DISPLAYED, BEFORE START C/L, then PARK BRK OFF on ground crew clearance. ACCU PRESS indicator......CHECK PF (00017116) precedes and is not on the card.

notes: CA becomes PF if both pilots not trained

flow_trigger.text: PF sets ENG Start to NORM

fcom.note: Permits normal pack operation and starts the After Start flow (PRO-NOR-SOP-09-A-00019960.0001001). Warm-up: idle or near idle 5 min cold, 3 min warm, taxi time counts.
Avoids ingestion of engine exhaust gases. X BLEED selector......AS RQRD PF (PRO-NOR-SOP-09-A-C0000281.9001001, new this revision) sits between ENG START and APU BLEED and is not on the card.
Then RUD TRIM......CHECK NEUTRAL PM; up to 0.6 deg residual is normal.
ON for all ground operations when icing conditions exist or are anticipated. WING ANTI-ICE pb-sw......AS RQRD PF is the next DU (00011046).
Then FLAPS......CHECK POSITION PM on the ECAM upper display. Keep flaps retracted until the holding point when taxiing in icing conditions with rain, slush or snow.
If the APU is not required.
Check the takeoff CG on the PITCH TRIM wheel using the ECAM CG indication.
FCOM role is BOTH: the PM checks and the PF crosschecks that there is no STS reminder on the E/WD.
THRUST SETTING......CROSSCHECK PF (PRO-NOR-SOP-09-A-00027845.0001001, new this revision: FLEX temperature on the E/WD vs FMS PERF page) sits between NWS DISC and NWS Fault Lt and is not on the card.

FCOM splits the item: BRAKE PEDALS......PRESS PF, BRAKES......CHECK PF, BRAKE FAN pb......AS RQRD PM, BRAKES PRESSURE......CHECK AT ZERO PM. Both pilots act, so the coordinated marker stands. Caution: first low-speed brake application is less effective after parking in wet conditions.
At a convenient stage, before or during taxi.
Review the ATC clearance before checking the AFS/Flight Instruments.
AFS/FLIGHT INSTRUMENTS: CLEARED ALTITUDE ON FCU CHECK PM, HDG ON FCU IF REQUIRED PRESET PM, BOTH FD CHECK ON PM.
Airspeeds, initial target altitude, heading, FMA modes on the PFD; SID on the ND.
Consider radar on the PF side and TERR ON ND on the PM side only.
IGN/START if heavy rain, moderate turbulence, or severe turbulence expected after takeoff.
Then CAPT DISPLAY mode selector ALL PM and F/O DISPLAY mode selector ALL PM; 30 s to fill the 3D buffer.
Check the EWD displays T.O CONFIG NORMAL.
Same DU then has Cabin......NA/ADVISED PM (takeoff PA no less than two minutes before takeoff), which the card carries only in the checklist trigger.

cl_trigger.text: T.O. Config pb pressed & cabin advised

phases.label: Line-Up
phases.title: Line-Up Flow

fcom.note: Confirm the intended runway and intersection using markings, lights, ILS signal, ND runway symbol, RAAS.
TA/RA is the default; TA ONLY at specific airports and procedures per Jeppesen 10-7 pages.
Visually and using the TCAS display on the ND.
To cross or enter a runway. The PF can request the PM to set the exterior lights.

fcom.line: PACK 1 pb-sw and PACK 2 pb-sw......AS RQRD
fcom.note: Packs OFF or APU bleed ON as directed by the TPR/TLR, set at least 20 s before takeoff thrust. APU bleed not permitted with wing anti-ice.

notes: Resume normal tasksharing if both pilots not trained

fcom.note: ABOVE ACCELERATION ALTITUDE (OR ONCE IN CLIMB PHASE), ACCELERATION FLOW PATTERN: at F speed FLAPS 1 ORDER PF / SELECT PM; at S speed FLAPS 0 ORDER PF / SELECT PM.

steps.text: RW TO Lt OFF, Nose Lt OFF

fcom.note: Same DU: NOSE sw......OFF PM. FCOM order is NOSE then RWY TURN OFF.

CSTR on one side for grid MORA, ARPT on the other. The flow pattern DU PRO-NOR-SOP-14-A-00019949.0001001 states: the PF will select CSTR, the PM will select ARPT. FCOM titles this AT 10 000 FT MSL; the card says AAL.

steps.text: LAND Lt OFF, WING Lt OFF

fcom.note: LAND sw OFF is verified. WING Lt OFF has no FCOM step at 10 000 ft; the FCOM WING sw OFF steps are in Cockpit Preparation (PRO-NOR-SOP-06-A-00011862.0001001), After Landing (PRO-NOR-SOP-21-A-00011013.0001001) and Parking (PRO-NOR-SOP-22-A-00012195.0003001). The Exterior Light Usage table on the card also lists only Land OFF here.

fcom.line: NO SMOKING sw......ON, wait 3 s, AUTO
fcom.note: Cycle to inform additional aircraft occupants of leaving sterile, if required.
Flow pattern DU 00019949: the PM will select ARPT.
Three lines in the DU: NAVAIDS......CLEAR PM (manually tuned VORs on RAD NAV), SEC F-PLN......AS RQRD PM (recopy active), OPT FL/REC MAX FL......CHECK PM (PROG page).

phases.label: Descent 10,000'
phases.title: Descending 10,000' Flow

fcom.note: Select CSTR on both sides.
Press LS for ILS, GLS, ILS G/S out, LOC only, LOC B/C, FLS or SLS approaches; check deviation scales and IDENT on the PFD.

fcom.line: NO SMOKING sw......ON, wait 3 sec, AUTO
fcom.note: SEAT BELTS sw......ON PM precedes it in the same DU and is not on the card (also required no later than 18 000 ft, PRO-NOR-SOP-17-A-90000464.9000393).
Appropriate navaids tuned and identified. Accur is NAVIGATION ACCURACY......MONITOR PF in PRO-NOR-SOP-17-A-00015240.0001001, conditional on GPS PRIMARY LOST.
IGN if standing water on the runway, heavy rain or severe turbulence expected on approach or in the go-around area.

notes: At taxi speed CA becomes PF if both pilots not trained

fcom.note: Card says Gnd Splrs OFF; FCOM line is GND SPLRS......DISARM PF, when the runway is vacated. Same lever action (speed brake lever pushed down out of the ARM detent); the card's own flow trigger says PF disarms Gnd Splrs. Wording-level conflict.
Then CAPT DISPLAY mode selector OFF PM and F/O DISPLAY mode selector OFF PM, to avoid radiating persons at the gate.
When leaving the runway. Same DU also has WING sw......OFF PF, which the card omits. During taxi the PF may request the PM to set the exterior lights.
When crossing a runway: STROBE sw ON and LAND LIGHT sw ON, same DU.
Set lever to 0. Do not retract until after shutdown and ground crew check if the approach was in icing conditions or the runway was contaminated with slush or snow.
ATC......AS RQRD PM is the next DU, PRO-NOR-SOP-21-A-00011023.0001001, set per airport requirements.
If used: APU MASTER SW pb-sw ON PM, APU START pb ON PM. Start may be delayed until before engine shutdown; check AVAIL before shutdown.
Ground idle is increased with engine anti-ice on; control taxi speed.
Green band; with low accumulator pressure chocks are required before engine shutdown.
Then BRAKES PRESS indicator......CHECK PF; keep pedals pressed until both needles are above the green area. Avoid applying if one brake is above 500 C (350 C with fans ON).
If the APU is used, set ON and wait for the APU BLEED memo, then shut down the engines immediately.
No less than 1 min after high thrust operations. Preceded by EXT A(B) pb CHECK AVAIL and ON (APU not used) or APU START pb CHECK AVAIL (APU used), PF; followed by ENGINE PARAMETERS......CHECK PF.

EXTERIOR LIGHTS DU: WING sw OFF, BEACON sw OFF (when all engines spooled down), OTHER EXTERIOR LIGHTS AS RQRD: RWY TURN OFF sw OFF, LAND LIGHT sw OFF, NOSE sw OFF, STROBE sw OFF, NAV & LOGO sw 1. All PF.
Card says ATC OFF; FCOM line is ATC......STBY PM. Different selector position.

On the FMS POSITION/MONITOR page check the deviation does not exceed the FCOM table. The table is a figure not present in the text extraction, so the card's <5 threshold could not be confirmed against it.
On the DOOR/OXY SD page; warn the cabin crew if any slide is not disarmed.
FOB plus fuel used consistent with FOB at departure; unusual discrepancy needs maintenance action.

callouts.pf: PARKING BRAKE SET or RELEASED, whichever pilot operates it

callouts.trigger: Gear selection

CAT II, DA(H)
